fields.Intake — Published:
300 approved PG two-year management seats in 2023–24 (NIRF 2025); institutional PGDM/PGDM-FM pool, with no split in this source.
Published numeric intake: 300
fields.Fees — Published:
₹12.85 lakh (PGDM/PGDM-FM batch 2026-28); hostel and refundable items subject to schedule
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 12.85
fields.Fee Scope: ₹12.85 lakh programme fee includes tuition, resource centre, exams, IT, welfare and learning/development. Refundable caution money and optional accommodation require separate offer confirmation.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT, GMAT, ATMA
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: Official 2026–28 brochure: minimum 60 percentile in an accepted CAT/XAT/GMAT/CMAT/MAT/ATMA exam; not an expected 55–70 band.
fields.Eligibility: Official 2026–28 brochure: recognised bachelor’s degree of at least three years with minimum 50% aggregate; final-year candidates may apply with proof by October 2026.
fields.Selection Process: Entrance score, academics and work profile screening, followed by written ability, speaking skills and personal interview; current assessment invitation governs schedule.
fields.Avg CTC — Published:
₹9 LPA overall (Class 2026); top 10%14,top 20%13,top 50%9.5 are not overall averages
Reported mean ₹L: 9
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹6.63 LPA, 2023–24 graduating PG two-year management pool (NIRF 2025). Separate from 2026 mean and top-50% salary.
Reported median ₹L: 6.63
fields.Highest CTC — Published:
₹19.2 LPA (Class 2026; FIIB PGDM class of 2026)
Reported highest ₹L: 19.2
fields.Placement — Published:
86 of 88 minimum-time PG two-year graduates placed in 2023–24; zero higher studies; 97.73% placed/graduates (derived).
Published/calculated rate %: 97.73
fields.Placement Scope: Class of 2026 official report: overall mean ₹9 LPA, highest ₹19.2 LPA; top-10/20/50% statistics are separate. NIRF 2025 reports older 2023–24 pooled PG two-year median ₹6.63 LPA and 86/88 placed; these are not the 2026 cohort.
fields.Top Recruiters: Tata Capital; Grant Thornton Bharat; Genpact; WNS; Ameriprise; Deloitte; MRF; Kuehne+Nagel (2026 employer testimonials)
fields.Official Role Examples: Official alumni career histories: Analyst; Sales Manager–Branch Banking; Audit and Assurance Consultant; Management Trainee–HRBP; Financial Analyst. These are 2021–24 alumni histories, not a 2026 placement-role distribution.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Revalidated official 2026 report; fee updated from legacy 10.10 L to 12.85 L for 2026-28. PGDM/PGDM-FM admissions are marketed jointly; no median separately disclosed.
